mechanicStacking.effect: +1 Remnant and +35% density (city maps or overlapping towers only)

notes.text: Tablets socket into completed Precursor Towers, never the Map Device. A map inherits the tablets of towers in range.
Towers hold 1–3 tablets (cleared with 0, 3 or 6 explicit Waystone modifiers). 4 tablets on one map needs overlapping tower radii, or a City Biome map with Industrial Improvements.
Rare tablets roll 3 modifiers; 4 (2 prefixes, 2 suffixes) needs both Reverse Transcription and Partial Translation.
Waystone: rare 6 modifiers (3+3); Vaal corruption can reach 10 (5+5). Tier 16 only through corruption. Area level = tier + 64.
Item Rarity does not raise raw currency, rune or Waystone drop volume; it carries weight 0 in currency presets where the fact-check says so.
Tablet affix spawn weights are server-side and not in the client files; spawnWeight is null everywhere and unused.
Mechanic-specific tablet mods are filed as suffixes (the fact-check heading); their affix side is not shown per mod by the source.

map_pack_size_+%.why: Multiplies total entities slain across the zone.

map_magic_monsters_+%.why: Secondary volume driver; effective for experience and base drops.

layerDetect.why: Companion heuristic, not from the fact-check: a defence layer counts as relied on when its figure is at least this share of the largest of ES, armour and evasion.

fitsBuild.why: Companion rule, not from the fact-check: a farm fits your build when its starter loadout's danger, rated for the layers your build relies on, is below the same loadout's generic danger (ratio under maxRatio). It compares two readings of the same data; it adds no new weight.

fixtures.name: Fact-check 1: Abyss, 3 rare tablets, 4-mod keystones
fixtures.why: Fact-check fixture 1 maths: tablet effect 1.85, Waystone effect 1.09. Its Tablet 3 rolls 30% Abyssal Depths chance, above the 10–20 range the same document lists, so validate() reports 1 range error. The fact-check Net percentages are not asserted: they cannot be reproduced from its data.

fixtures.name: Fact-check 2: Expedition, 4 rare tablets on a City map
fixtures.why: Fact-check fixture 2 maths (tablet effect 2.28). The source loadout puts 3 suffixes on every tablet, against its own 2-suffix limit; validate() reports one error per tablet (4).

fixtures.name: Fact-check 3: Magic league start
fixtures.why: Fact-check fixture 3 maths (tablet effect 1.35). Its Waystone rolls (15% pack size, 20% extra Fire) sit below the only mod tier in the data (41–50, 36–40), so validate() reports 2 range errors.

fixtures.name: Fact-check 4: Breach, 3 rare tablets
fixtures.why: Fact-check fixture 4 maths (tablet effect 1.85). Two of its tablets carry 3 suffixes (2-suffix limit), so validate() reports 2 errors.

fixtures.name: Fact-check 5: Unique hunting (modelled mods only)
fixtures.why: Fact-check fixture 5 maths. Left out because the data has no such mod: +1 Area Level, 38% Waystone quantity, +2 Strongboxes, 15% Monster effectiveness on the Waystone.

quickPicks.patchNote: Patch 0.5.5, checked against 0.5.5e. 1.0 is reported for Dec 11, 2026; values may change.

excluded.why: Ritual is not in the five: the research notes call it oversupplied this patch.

disagreements.text: Sources disagree on how many mods a Waystone can hold: 6, 8 or 10.
Sources disagree on what a 4th Expedition tablet adds: +35% or +70% density. This page keeps +35%.

picks.name: Abyss + Rogue Exiles
picks.line: More rare monsters climb out of every Abyss.
picks.why: Common community setup: the two Abyss mods the preset weights most, plus Pack size.

picks.name: Expedition, 4 tablets
picks.line: Four Expedition tablets on a City map: more Logbooks, rares and Remnants.
picks.why: Common community setup: the four Expedition mods spread so each sits on two tablets; a City map lets four tablets reach it.

picks.name: Breach + Genesis Tree
picks.line: Breaches drop more Hiveblood and Wombgifts for the Genesis Tree.
picks.why: Common community setup: the three Breach mods the preset weights, spread two per tablet, plus Pack size.

picks.name: Delirium
picks.line: Fill the Delirium reward faster and get bigger Splinter stacks.
picks.why: Common community setup: the two Delirium mods the preset weights, plus Pack size.

picks.name: Unique hunting
picks.line: More rarity and quantity, and tougher map bosses that drop more.
picks.why: Common community setup: Item rarity and quantity on every tablet, boss mods on Overseer tablets.
